note: Tonga, read on 2026-10-30 on the visa pages of the Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga in Beijing (tongaembassycn.gov.to, a Government of Tonga site), which give each visa of Tonga's Immigration Division (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) with its requirements and the fee paid at the embassy, in US dollars (so the file's currency is USD; the fees paid in Tonga, in pa'anga, weren't found). The Employment Visa is required of a non-Tongan who wants to work in Tonga in the public service or private sector for any length of time, on a letter of support from the Ministry of Labour, Commerce and Industries, US$230, and normally takes one month to process (written as the time; the page says 'normally'); renewed applications need the Inland Revenue Department's letter on tax payments, so it is renewable; the holder may transfer employers by applying for a transfer, which the page says, so its work isn't written as tied. The Business Visa is for a non-Tongan or a foreign company setting up a business, US$345, must be applied for before entry (abroad), normally one month, renewable. The Residency Visa lets a person live in Tonga without an entry visa, on proof of Tongan ancestry, former Tongan citizenship or marriage to a Tongan (written as family), US$115 at 18 and over (US$54.50 under 18, not written). The Assured Income Visa is for non-Tongans retiring on an overseas pension or fund of at least TOP$10,000 a year, US$345; it allows residence but not work, study or a business (work none), is valid for 2 years or more (no term written, the page giving a least) and is renewable. The Student Visa, for students 18 and younger at school in Tonga, US$57.50, normally takes a month, is issued for up to one year (no term written) and is renewable. No page gives a term, permanent residence or naturalisation; where the employment, residency and assured income visas are applied for besides the embassy isn't said.

sources.title: Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga, Beijing: Employment Visa
sources.said: An Employment Visa is required for a person or group who wants to work in Tonga, either in the Public Service or Private Sector for any length of time. ... Letter of Support from Ministry of Labour, Commerce & Industries (MLCL). ... USD$230 money order payable to Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga, Beijing, PRC; or USD$230 Cash. ... For renewed applications, a letter of support from the Inland Revenue Department on history of tax payment(s) is required. ... An Employment Visa normally takes one month to process. ... The Immigration Division will allow the applicant to TRANSFER companies/businesses/ employers if they apply for a transfer of a visa and fulfills the necessary conditions for the transfer.

sources.title: Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga, Beijing: Business Visa
sources.said: A Business is required by a non Tongan Citizen or a foreign company who wishes to set up a business in Tonga. ... Cash payment of USD$345.00 or money order payable to Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga, Beijing, PRC. ... If renewing application, a letter of support from the Inland Revenue Department on history of tax payment(s) is required. ... A Business Visa normally takes one month to process. ... Application for a Business Visa must be done prior to entry into the Kingdom.

sources.title: Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga, Beijing: Residency Visa
sources.said: Any person can apply for Residency Visa, if this person wants to live in Tonga without having to apply for entry visa. ... Proof of Tongan ancestry, former Tongan or married to a Tongan ... USD$115.00 for eighteen years of age and over; USD$54.50 for under 18 years.

sources.title: Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga, Beijing: Assured Income Visa
sources.said: Eligible applicants are non-Tongan passport holders who wish to retire in Tonga and have a regular income from a pension or fund from an overseas source. ... Evidence of income of at least TOP$10,000.00 per annum with supporting documents. ... USD$345.00 in Cash or money order payable to Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga. ... The Assured Income Visa allows residency in Tonga but does not allow a successful applicant to work, study or start a business. ... Assured Income Visas are valid for 2 years or more and are renewable.

sources.title: Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga, Beijing: Student Visa
sources.said: All students 18 years of age and younger, and who intends to go to school in Tonga, whether at Primary, Secondary or Tertiary level. ... USD$ 57.50 Cash payment or money order payable to Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga, Beijing, PRC. ... Processing a Student Visa normally takes a month. ... Student Visas are issued for a period of up to ONE Year and are renewable.
